units.source_text: 夜里，家中只有挂钟的嘀嗒声和汽灯的燃烧声。

en.t: At night, only the ticking of the wall clock and the burning sound of the gas lamp could be heard in the house.

units.source_text: 从黢黑的里屋断断续续地传来向苍天倾诉似的声音：

en.t: From the pitch-dark back room came, intermittently, a voice that seemed to be pouring out its grief to the heavens:
